title: 5 Minute vs 5 Hour Vegan Cinnamon Rolls: Microwave Mug Roll and Cast-Iron Yeast Roll
summary: Goodful’s video showcases two vegan cinnamon roll methods in one episode: a 5-minute version baked in a mug using a quick icing, and a 5-hour yeast-based version that involves warm non-dairy milk, melted vegan butter, rising dough, rolling with a cinnamon-brown sugar filling, and baking in a buttered cast-iron pan, finished with a coffee-flavored icing and a coffee cake crumble. The host guides viewers through practical techniques such as patching dough scraps, sealing edges with water, and managing rising times, highlighting the trade-offs between speed and traditional, room-temperature dough development.

sections.description: The host demonstrates a quick, mug-based cinnamon roll: whip a simple icing, mix dry dough ingredients with non-dairy milk, form a flat disc, top with a cinnamon-sugar filling, seal the edges with water, roll into a log, place in a sprayed mug, and microwave the roll for about 75–90 seconds for a fast vegan treat.

sections.description: A yeast-based cinnamon roll process begins with warming dairy-free milk, combining with melted vegan butter and sugar to activate yeast, then adding flour, kneading, and shaping into a rectangle. The filling is prepared with brown sugar and cinnamon, which is spread, and the dough is rolled and assembled into a giant roll placed in a buttered cast-iron pan to rise and expand.
